verdict.rationale: RUN offers automation (RUN & DONE recurring payroll autopilot), so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents version history, change review, or rollback for automations or payroll configurations. The autopilot, AI error flagging and API Central integration features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
